text: ENDORSED BYManny A. SantosFormer Mayor of Meriden and 2018 candidate for Congress"Peter Lumaj will be an excellent choice for Connecticut Secretary of the State due to his deep commitment to election integrity, legal expertise, and personal resilience. As an immigrant who escaped communist Albania, Lumaj brings a profound appreciation for democratic values and the importance of transparent governance. His background as an attorney and small business owner equips him with the practical skills needed to modernize business filings and streamline state operations. Having previously run one of the closest statewide races in Connecticut history, Peter has demonstrated both broad appeal and a strong understanding of the state’s political landscape. His outspoken advocacy for secure elections and accountability makes him the best candidate for safeguarding Connecticut’s democratic processes"View all endorsements →
